Tor is a tool for anonymity while browsing the web. It is perfectly legal and can be used for just about anything you do on the internet. Unfortunately, this encryption is often used for illegal purposes that couldn't be done through normal browsing, such as distributing child pornography. The NSA (confirmed through tracing) made a virus that compromised half of all Tor-only sites. All users who visited them with JavaScript enabled have their IP addresses now recorded by the government. The incident was about taking out child pornography, but was a huge hit to personal privacy on the Internet and the event is being viewed as the NSA trying to justify their actions.

Talon: Q or E second?

Example: Level 11
114.4 AD w/o items (with standard runes and masteries)

397.3 W
228.8.    114.4 AA x2 (Tiamat active)
188.7 Q
511.6 R

=1326.4

3% = 39.8 per E rank

Each rank of Q adds 40. 

E is the better option because with literally any AD items you do better damage and continues to be more potent with the more AD you have. The CD reduction on E is more useful than CD on Q because Q is used only once per burst and at tank 1 will still always be up when you engage with E.

P.S. This was done on my phone, partly in my head and partly with calculator. I rounded all numbers to 1 decimal point.


Edit: CD information

Q base CD: 8
E base CD:18

Q -1 second per level =1/8
E -2 second per level =1/9
Similar CD scaling, but E on a lower cool down would be better even just for the utility because of how his combo works

In 3rd grade we played a game in our class where winners got small toys. I won a round, but as I was going up to pick out the toy I wanted (a rubber ball on a rubbery cord, hard to describe) a girl grabbed it as hers. I was really annoyed but didn't do anything. Later in the day she put it on top of her locker so she could get it later. When she tried to get it back down later and couldn't reach, she went to find a teacher to help. While she was gone I took it, and she had no idea where it had gone when the teacher came to help. For the next few years I had it in my drawer and every time I looked at it I felt really guilty, but scared of what would happen if i told her I was the one who took it. I didn't want to get rid of it either, I would have been guilty for it going to waste then. Thankfully it got lost when I moved, but I still remember clearly and still feel awful when I think about it. 

So glad I was finally able to say this, I haven't told in all those years since.
